image_source_directory: valid/images in the local Roboflow export

segmentation.aggregation: per-image metrics followed by macro average

yolo.map: instance mask mAP at 0.50 and averaged from 0.50 to 0.95

unet.map: not applicable because the checkpoint has no instances or confidence scores

computational_profile.image_loading: all 892 files read once before measurement to warm the OS cache; decoded images immediately released
computational_profile.latency_scope: warm-cache image decoding, model preprocessing, inference, synchronization, and prediction return
computational_profile.cpu_scale: process utilization divided by 32 logical processors; 0-100 percent
computational_profile.ram: peak process resident set size in MB
computational_profile.energy: NVML GPU-board power integrated over time and divided by 2676 measured inferences; J/image
